provenance: Cases of the order-family kinds (order, batch-order, cancel, cancel-fast, cancel-by-cloid, cancel-by-cloid-fast, modify-by-cloid, modify-by-oid, batch-modify, borrow-lend, borrow-lend-all) are written by tests/vectors/gen_order_family.py; the rest come from cw-enclave reference/vectors.json, section wire, written by reference/gen_wire_vectors.py. Cases with source sdk-method are built by hyperliquid-python-sdk's own Exchange methods; cases with source hand-built have no SDK method and carry the body shape HyperCore recovered the signer of on testnet, or the SDK body with the cancel fast flag added. Hashes and digests are the SDK's action_hash / construct_phantom_agent / l1_payload.
note: vault_address None, expires_after None; digest_* is the EIP-712 Agent digest the agent key signs, source a (mainnet) or b (testnet)
